list.title: Sensors
list.description: Overview of all sensors registered in the system. You can add new sensors by scanning the QR code on the sensor unit.

statusGrid.batteryShutoffDescription: The battery switches off below 2.8 V.

dataQuality.title: Data quality
dataQuality.discardedSummary_one: One reading was discarded in the last seven days.
dataQuality.discardedSummary_other: {count} readings were discarded in the last seven days.
dataQuality.acknowledgeDialogDescription: The previously discarded readings are then considered reviewed. If implausible values occur again, the sensor will flag them again on its own.
dataQuality.acknowledgeNotePlaceholder: Reason, e.g. probe was not connected during setup
dataQuality.acknowledgeFailedToast: The note could not be saved.

signalChart.title: RSSI history
signalChart.subtitle: Higher (less negative) = better reception
signalChart.tooFewDataPoints: Not enough data points in the selected period.

soilMoistureChart.title: Soil moisture history
soilMoistureChart.subtitleHour: Hourly average · band = min–max · dashed = critical threshold per depth
soilMoistureChart.subtitleDay: Daily average · band = min–max · dashed = critical threshold per depth
soilMoistureChart.tooFewDataPoints: Not enough data points in the selected period.

linkedTree.title: Linked tree
linkedTree.noLinkDescription: This sensor is not linked to any tree. Without a link, its readings cannot be attributed to any vegetation.
linkedTree.loadFailedDescription: The linked tree (#{id}) could not be retrieved.

location.title: Location
location.mapAriaLabel: Map with the sensor position, nearby trees and watering groups
location.derivedFromTreeNotice: The position is taken from the linked tree.
location.notInFieldTitle: Sensor not yet in the field
location.notInFieldDescription: This sensor has not been activated yet and has no location. Once it is assigned to a tree or bed, a map will appear here.

lorawanConfig.title: Advanced LoRaWAN configuration
lorawanConfig.secretsWarningDescription: LoRaWAN keys (APPKEY, APPSKEY, NWKSKEY, PWORD) are hidden by default and can be revealed individually. They are automatically redacted when copied.

actions.deleteConfirmDescription: This action cannot be undone. Sensor {id} will be permanently removed, including its LoRaWAN configuration and all readings.
actions.deleteFailedToast: The sensor could not be deleted.
actions.removeConfirmTitle: Remove tree link and reset sensor?
actions.removeConfirmDescription: The tree link will be removed and the sensor reset to the "{status}" state. It can then be activated on another tree like a new sensor.

activate.title: Activate sensor and assign tree
activate.description: Search for the tree by number or species and activate the sensor on this tree.

reassign.description: Choose the new tree this sensor should be assigned to.

treeSearch.idleHint: Type a tree number or species.
treeSearch.noResultsHint: Check the spelling or tree number.

treePickerSheet.title: Choose a different tree
treePickerSheet.description: Search by tree number or species if the right tree is not in the suggestion list.

header.title: Scan sensor QR code
header.description: Hold the QR code on the sensor unit steady inside the scan frame. This uniquely identifies the sensor before you assign it to a tree in the next step. In poor lighting, it helps to hold the code a little closer.

checking.title: Checking sensor
checking.description: We're matching the scanned ID against the database. This only takes a moment.

notFound.title: Sensor not found
notFound.description: This sensor ID is not registered in the system.
notFound.hint: Make sure the sensor unit was registered in the system through administration, or contact the admin.

badRequest.title: Invalid sensor ID
badRequest.description: The scanned ID does not match the expected format.
badRequest.hint: Please check that you scanned the correct QR code on the sensor unit.

network.title: Matching failed
network.description: Matching against the database could not be performed.
network.hint: Please check your internet connection and try again.

notActivatable.title: Sensor cannot be activated
notActivatable.onlineDescription: This sensor is already activated and assigned to a tree.
notActivatable.offlineDescription: This sensor has already been activated and is currently offline.

recognized.title: Sensor recognized
recognized.description: Known in the system and cleared for activation.

header.title: Assign tree
header.description: Choose the tree the sensor will be mounted on. The suggestion is based on your current location. Only the tree assignment is saved on the sensor, not your coordinates.

searchFailed.title: Tree search failed
searchFailed.description: The search for nearby trees failed.

tree.noNearbyTrees: No nearby trees were found. Choose the tree manually.

header.title: Review assignment
header.description: Confirm sensor, tree and location. The link is saved once you select "Activate sensor".
